'''Doug Roan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 I-10 Cup]] on 20 January 2001 with Bothawui (A-wing asteroids), according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1666">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-24-vipers-day-1-i-10-cup-1-20-01d1666/ vipers-day-1-i-10-cup-1-20-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 24 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-24-vipers-day-1-i-10-cup-1-20-01d1666/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
